about.title: Wasco Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone in a preventable crash changes everything, and Wasco families shouldn't have to sort through legal deadlines while grieving. Kern County recorded traffic deaths on local roads in the most recent final year, a reminder that even a smaller city sees serious collisions along corridors like Rt 46, Rt 43, F Street, and Palm Avenue, where crashes tend to cluster on Sunday afternoons. California law gives surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents and heirs eligible if none of those exist. There's a two-year window from the date of death to file, shorter if a government entity was involved, so timing matters. LawProactive is a free service that connects grieving families with an independent personal injury attorney who can explain what compensation might be available, including funeral costs, lost financial support, and loss of companionship, without any obligation.

items.title: Who Can File Matters
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases to spouses, domestic partners, and children first, with certain dependents or heirs eligible only if none exist. An attorney can help clarify where your family fits.

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, and that window shrinks if a government entity was involved. Waiting too long can close the door on recovery entirely.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Bills
items.desc: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. A civil claim is separate from any criminal case and focuses on what the family lost.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in Wasco?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file. If a government agency, such as a public road authority, may be involved, that deadline is often much shorter. It's worth speaking with an attorney early so no options are lost.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim after a Kern County crash?
items.answer: California law gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of those survive the deceased, certain other dependents or heirs may be eligible to file. An independent attorney can review your family's specific situation.

items.question: Does a criminal case against the other driver affect our civil claim?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal charges the driver might face. Even if criminal proceedings are slow or don't result in a conviction, a family can still pursue a civil claim independently. The two processes run on their own timelines.

items.question: What kinds of losses can a wrongful death claim in Wasco cover?
items.answer: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Every family's situation looks different, so it helps to discuss specifics with an attorney familiar with these claims.
